mission: Prospectively transfer the accepted P8 applicability-basis law and P9 fresh-synthesis stopping law into materially different Security and Finance worlds without creating a new shared service.
questionOrHypothesis: P8: does planning/derivation-time exact applicability basis reduce false stale-use in Security derived evidence versus generation/currentness and raw current authority? P9: does fresh synthesis interrupt acquisition inertia on a structured finite Finance dataset universe, and what evidence boundary/order effects remain?
evidenceSelection: Current Security EC1 owner-native derived-evidence applicability, including its natural generation-2 metadata-only and generation-3 history-advance cases; frozen read-only Finance Parquet snapshot across six OKX TradFi datasets for SPY/QQQ/XAU/SMH. No live trade or external Security effect.
strongBaseline: P8 generation-only and raw current Security authority. P9 same-context self-stop after explicit finite dataset acquisition, zero-evidence synthesis, incomplete coverage checkpoints, and full-evidence order perturbation.
negativeControl: P8 authority unavailable must hold unknown. P9 zero observations must not reconstruct hidden Finance state; 1-5 dataset checkpoints must not be treated as strict closure when requested dependencies are absent.
candidate: P8 predeclared exact dependency comparison as evidence for Agent/domain applicability. P9 bounded evidence acquisition followed by fresh synthesis after dependency coverage.
independentOracle: Security owner EC1 current applicability.py outputs are hidden and byte-replayed; Finance oracle is mechanically computed from frozen Parquet using DuckDB and checked against every inspect_dataset summary.
invalidityConditions: Expose Security APPLICABLE/STALE/UNKNOWN classifier output to P8 Agent.
Use Finance final audit JSON as an observation instead of frozen raw/near-raw Parquet queries.
Read mutable canonical Finance state after the freeze during P9 trials.
Replace a semantic failure through rerun.
Silently coerce invalid Provider structured output.
Treat evidence coverage as order-invariant without perturbation.
authorityBoundary: Security owns applicability semantics for its derived evidence; Finance owns its DataPlane observations; Computing only freezes/compares/evaluates experiment evidence. No live Finance effect, Security attack action, shared applicability authority, or stopping service is created.

budget.note: wire-invalid no-semantic-output attempts add additional uncounted Provider cost

stopRule: Stop after P8 has owner-native hidden-oracle replication, P9 has self-stop baseline, 0-through-complete dependency coverage curve, full-evidence order perturbation, and every no-semantic-output cell is dispositioned without replacing semantic failures.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: No new long-lived P8/P9 service or CLI is expected. Full runners/raw trial records/frozen Parquet are snapshotted once in Git and then contracted; retain compact evidence/report and world-model updates only.
publicationBoundary: Do not publish ApplicabilityService, StoppingService, CriticService, fixed observation thresholds, a global dependency ontology, or an order-normalization authority from this round.
